# Vendored third-party code

`axe.min.js` is [axe-core](https://github.com/dequelabs/axe-core) 4.14.0 by Deque Systems, copied unmodified from the `axe-core` npm package. It is licensed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0 (see `AXE-LICENSE.txt`).

It is committed to the repo so test runs do not depend on a CDN and always use the same axe version.
